resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two Big Hill towers appear in these sources: a Cumberland County tower at 2,035 feet (Landforms) and a Marion County tower at 2,032 feet (National Register nomination). The record's county and elevation (620.3 m, which is 2,035 feet) match the Cumberland tower, so the record stays Cumberland and the Marion tower's history is kept out of it.

sources.title: Big Hill Fire Lookout Tower National Register nomination

notes_for_editor: Two Big Hill towers: this record (Cumberland County, 2,035 ft per Landforms; elevation_m 620.3 matches) and the NRHP-nominated Marion County tower (2,032 ft; built around 1947 per the nomination, date estimated). Do not share history between them; if a Marion County record exists, it should carry the nomination's history. No Cumberland-specific build, builder, staffing or access source was found. A Facebook group post seen only in a search snippet says a Big Hill tower is gated, quarry-owned and not open to the public; it does not name the county, so it is not used. Read and search budgets are used up for this record.
